# omarchy-eval-tiers

The tier semantics — a claim in a report is only as strong as the tier that
produced it. Never claim live-system behavior from a container run.

- Tier-1 container (pod): proves the PR's files are applied to the installed
  tree and the script-level logic with the container's REAL tools. Does NOT
  prove live system behavior.
- Tier-2 live VM (omarchy-vm): proves the PR's behavior on a real omarchy
  system — real cardwire, real btrfs snapshots, real flatpak, real network,
  real desktop. The tier for system-behavior claims.
- Tier-2 visual / L3 GPU: desktop evidence and hardware-bound classes
  (NOT_TESTABLE_PR when the hardware is unavailable — never a faked bed).

The routing rule: the class decides the tier. Hardware-bound classes are
NOT_TESTABLE_PR with the concrete reason, never a faked bed.
